author: IAmSpoonz
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

Hello, my username is Tkd01. A little while back I was banned for fly hacking. I would like to appeal this punnishment. This is my first time getting banned from Avicus. I feel like I should appologize for my actions. So I apologize to your server and staff. I have been banned for over 6 months now and I don't hack anymore. I use vanilla minecraft. I would like to know if you would take my application to get my punishment appealed.

From,
Tkd01

replies.body:
Hello tkd01,

Because you have been banned for almost half a year and you seem very apologetic i will appeal this punishment.   

Welcome back.

Regards,

Posigndun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
